convention.name: sideNavigation
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied primary navigation region that a layout template docks beside its main content, such as a sidebar or compact rail organism.
convention.whenToUse: An application layout places an already composed side navigation organism and owns its docking, sticky positioning and responsive visibility, while the organism owns its navigation data and behavior.
convention.avoid: Navigation data or entry arrays (use items), utility entries inside a navigation region (use endItems), panel metadata (use footer), secondary non-navigation panels or a bottom bar (use bottomNavigation).

convention.name: bottomNavigation
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied primary navigation region that a layout template docks at the bottom edge of the view below its main content, such as a mobile tab bar organism.
convention.whenToUse: An application layout shows a bottom bar of top-level destinations on narrow viewports, owning its docking and responsive visibility while the organism owns its destinations.
convention.avoid: Navigation data or entry arrays (use items), page footers or metadata (use footer), floating action buttons, sheets or drawers, or side regions (use sideNavigation).
